en.name: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025
en.description: A structured challenge for established LATAM companies preparing to enter China with distribution, channel, and go-to-market support.
en.detailSubtitle: Built for scale-ups and established companies that already have traction and now need a stronger landing strategy for China.
en.metaTitle: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025 | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Explore the China Market Entry Accelerator 2025 for LATAM companies expanding into China.
en.overviewHtml: This accelerator helps qualified companies pressure-test their China market-entry strategy before they spend heavily on channels, distributors, or local setup.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Established companies or scale-ups with a validated product and existing revenue.
  • Teams preparing for China-facing distribution, e-commerce, retail, or enterprise sales.
  • Operators that need a practical landing plan instead of generic market commentary.
en.supportHtml:
• Structured market-entry review and prioritization support.
  • Access to relevant channel, partner, and ecosystem conversations.
  • Guidance on packaging submissions, decks, and operating narrative.
en.processHtml:
1. Submit through the shared competition application form.
  2. Share commercial context, product fit, and expansion objectives.
  3. Continue with follow-up review and organizer-facing preparation.

br.name: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025
br.description: Um desafio estruturado para empresas LATAM prontas para entrar na China com apoio de distribuicao, canais e go-to-market.
br.detailSubtitle: Feito para scale-ups e empresas estabelecidas que ja tem tracao e agora precisam de uma estrategia mais forte de entrada na China.
br.metaTitle: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025 | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca o China Market Entry Accelerator 2025 para empresas LATAM em expansao para a China.
br.overviewHtml: Este accelerator ajuda empresas qualificadas a testar sua estrategia de entrada na China antes de investir pesado em canais, distribuidores ou estrutura local.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Empresas estabelecidas ou scale-ups com produto validado e receita.
  • Times preparando distribuicao, e-commerce, varejo ou vendas enterprise na China.
  • Operadores que precisam de um plano pratico e nao apenas comentario generico de mercado.
br.supportHtml:
• Revisao estruturada de entrada em mercado e priorizacao.
  • Acesso a conversas com canais, parceiros e ecossistema.
  • Orientacao para empacotar submissao, deck e narrativa operacional.
br.processHtml:
1. Envie pelo formulario padrao da competicao.
  2. Compartilhe contexto comercial, aderencia do produto e objetivos de expansao.
  3. Siga para revisao e preparacao orientada aos organizadores.

cn.name: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025
cn.description: 面向成熟拉美企业的结构化挑战赛，帮助团队获得进入中国市场所需的渠道、分销和落地支持。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合已经具备商业牵引力、现在需要更强中国落地策略的成长型企业和成熟公司。
cn.metaTitle: China Market Entry Accelerator 2025 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 China Market Entry Accelerator 2025，适合准备进入中国市场的拉美企业。
cn.overviewHtml: 该加速项目帮助符合条件的企业在投入大量渠道、分销商或本地设置成本前，先验证中国市场进入策略。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 拥有已验证产品和现有收入的成熟企业或成长型公司。
  • 准备在中国开展分销、电商、零售或企业销售的团队。
  • 需要实操落地方案而不是泛泛市场评论的运营者。
cn.supportHtml:
• 结构化市场进入评估与优先级建议。
  • 对接相关渠道、伙伴和生态资源。
  • 帮助整理提交材料、演示文档和运营叙事。
cn.processHtml:
1. 通过统一竞赛申请表提交。
  2. 说明商业背景、产品契合度和扩张目标。
  3. 继续完成后续审核和面向主办方的准备工作。
